account_number.description: Virginia withholding account number: 15 characters starting with 30 (withholding) or 38 (pass-through entity), hyphens removed, e.g. 30 + FEIN + F001

rules: Virginia requires one RS record per employee, with state code 51; SSA does not require RS.
Virginia reads the RE record (tax year in positions 3-6, FEIN, name) and the RS records. Other EFW2 records may be included but are not used or validated.
If an RE record has an error, Virginia does not review its RS records until it is corrected.
Records may be separated by CR/LF; each record except the last is followed by exactly one CR/LF.
Only one form type per file. Virginia recommends naming the file 'W2 REPORT', optionally with the tax year, and no special characters.

source.title: Virginia Tax, Web Upload Guide for W-2 and 1099 files (Appendix A)
